description: Camera/arrival adapters and rules of the accepted POC C1-I, classified. 'kind' separates recovered ROM behaviour, deliberate widescreen adapters (documented in the code header), legacy non-ROM rules (inherited from the pre-C1-I zone cameras, not documented as an adapter and not matched to the ROM) and omissions of a ROM rule. line_at_c1i is the line in the C1-I checkout; anchor is the text to search after a re-baseline.

rows.what: creation band measured from the live right edge, not from a 256 px window
rows.rom_basis: ROM creates the object in the outer spawn ring of the 256 px window ($80EB, object-50.json placement_window)

rows.what: arena right edge and patrol right turn extended by W-256 (world rectangle)
rows.rom_basis: none: the ROM arena is the screen clamp at the locked camera; T2 shows the viewport clamp gives the same rectangle

rows.what: mode 1 follows Sonic by centring him (never back-scrolling); Y is frozen at the creation value for modes 1-2
rows.rom_basis: ROM keeps the ordinary $5832 follow (lead 104/136, zone +-8/+-16, cap 7) and only raises the left limit (state 1 $9771 -> $8199)

rows.what: mode 3 pan 1 px/update/axis to (1679,78) at every width
rows.rom_basis: table $9808 row 0: anchor + (-256,-160), exclusive right limit

rows.what: state 18 ends when the anchor is 223 px right of the LIVE camera (world 1902 after the pan), at every width
mode 4 (release) centres on Sonic in one update
rows.rom_basis: ROM resumes the ordinary follow, <= 7 px/update (T1-02)

rows.what: fight camera X target 1664-(W-256) (1572 at 348): keeps the canonical RIGHT edge 1919 and exposes the extra width to the LEFT
fight camera Y 96 -> 112 for wide, tall views (presentation only)
the creation callback writes the CANONICAL right limit 1664 (exclusive camera limit, right edge 1920) at every width; the adapter in A-GPZ-1 is not applied to the limit
rows.rom_basis: ROM $9A99 writes D282 = 1664 and relocates the head 1728 -> 1856 (one update after creation); the limit is WORLD-fixed 270 px ahead of the camera

rows.what: modes 1 and 4: centre on Sonic horizontally; vertical target player.y - h/1.5; one-update snap at 256, 4 px/update at wide
rows.rom_basis: ROM keeps the ordinary follow throughout the approach (no mode-1 owner)

rows.what: first takeover starts from the last normal view, not from GameMaker's object-follow value
mode 2/3 approach to the width-adjusted target from EITHER side at 1 px/update (no snap)
pan target X = 3232 - W (canonical RIGHT edge kept; extra width to the left); Y stays 462
wide pan bounded to 4 px/update per axis
modes 1-2: X centres on Sonic (left limit raised, so the camera stalls until Sonic passes the centre); Y = player.y - h/1.5 (snap at 256, 4 px/update wide)
rows.rom_basis: ROM keeps the ordinary follow (lead 104, Y lead 96/120, zone +-8/+-16, cap 7)

rows.what: trigger lowers the right limit to the camera ($0356)
pan target X = 3269 - (W-48): boss stays at RIGHT-48 (209 at 256, 301 at 348); canonical right edge kept
wide pan bounded to 4 px/update per axis
modes 1-2: Y target player.y - h/1.5 capped 7 (256) / 4 (wide) per update; X centres on Sonic with the left limit raised
rows.rom_basis: ROM keeps the ordinary follow; the pan Y target is 256 only from state 3

rows.what: trigger lowers the right limit to the camera ($0356)
state 1 copies the right limit but never raises the left limit to the camera ($8199 -> $0353) and never lowers the right limit to the camera at the trigger ($0356)
rows.rom_basis: ROM: right limit := camera at the trigger (u99: limit 1642 with the camera at 1646), left raised every update (data/t2/boss-arrival.json AQZ)

rows.what: modes 1-2 centre on Sonic horizontally (limit = camera_right, which is never lowered, see A-AQZ-1) and use player.y - h/1.5 vertically
the $5A parts get a fixed VIEW-space translation intro_dx = W-256+ceil(wait/2) when the intro callback $AC38 runs; draw AND contact use the translated X; canonical xu is never changed
rows.rom_basis: ROM spawns the parts at WORLD 2048 = EDGE(RIGHT,+65) of the settled 256 px camera

rows.what: at wide the $5A parts are hidden and skipped until the pan has been settled for 16 updates
state 3 relocation adds W-256 to the canonical +128 (2208 at 256, 2300 at 348): a WORLD coordinate change that keeps the boss off-screen right at the settled camera
rows.rom_basis: ROM relocates 2080 -> 2208 (screen 337 before the pan, 257 after)

rows.what: wide trigger also fires when Sonic is right of the boss inside the view
follow with the ROM zone/lead/cap form (CENTER-relative leads at wide), left/right/bottom limits written by the boss
the pan clamps the camera Y to the new bottom limit in the first pan update
rows.rom_basis: ROM pans 1 px/update from the current Y (387 -> 334 in 53 updates, no clamp)

rows.what: the C1-I ordinary follow is switched off as soon as ANY boss owner is active (THZ3 mode != 0, GPZ3 active, MGHZ3/SEZ3/AQZ3 active); the ROM has no such owner switch before the pan
rows.rom_basis: ROM O4/O5: the ordinary follow keeps running with the left limit raised and, after the trigger, the right limit at the camera (data/t2/owner-map.json)

rows.what: player edge clamp EDGE(LEFT,+16)..EDGE(RIGHT,-9) of the live view as full-width integers, applied from boss creation for GPZ3/MGHZ3/SEZ3/AQZ3 (T2-04: THZ3 is not in the list)
